items.title: Record canonical noninteractive launcher readiness per review host
items.context: Extend host availability proof beyond binary/version presence. Each canonical host row should report the launcher shape used for reviewer work, whether the CLI supports it, whether a bounded smoke can start/finish or produce first progress, and a failureKind for auth, wrong flags, timeout, missing executable, or silent-final-output only.

items.title: Use execution-ready host counts for degraded fallback and host dispatch diagnostics
items.context: Non-human degraded fallback must not be eligible just because two hosts fail launcher/auth readiness after passing --version. The gate should distinguish availableHostCount from reviewReadyHostCount/executionReadyHostCount and explain when Codex token invalidation, Claude silent mode, or agy wrong flags require full 3x2 remediation or explicit-human-approval.

items.title: Cover Claude stream-json verbose, Codex exec auth, and agy print launcher with smoke tests
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage that proves Claude observable launcher is claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json, plain --print is classified as silent/non-progress for long reviewer work, agy --prompt-file is rejected while agy --print/--print-timeout is canonical, and Codex version/login without codex exec success is not review-ready.
